item.title:
For any existing Validators that're actively Validating people, if u are looking for a tool to determine Sybils or bad actors, here's the tool I've built for my own purpose 👀

> Original version of the script was kinda slow and might took hours (had difficult logic), I made some changes without any impact to final outcome. Now it takes from 2 mins and up to 10/15/20 mins (for heavy old wallets)

You can inspect the code via GPT if u want, to make sure it's clean for ya 

>  Bot is free, all you need Alchemi + Ankr API + create TG bot (I'm used to bot instead of web UI)

GitHub > https://t.co/Kg0qoCoUH5
